test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Baking soda is NOT generally used:
solution:
The correct answer is __**as a disinfectant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sodium Bi Carbonate:

 
 
• It is called baking soda. 
 
• Chemically it is NaHCO3. 
 
• It is used for making baking powder, bread etc. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sodium Hydroxide:

 
 
• The common name for sodium hydroxide is called caustic soda. 
 
• Chemically, it is NaOH. 
 
• It is used for cleaning purposes and making soaps. 
 
 
 
• Calcium Oxide:
 
 
• It is also known as 'Bina Booja Choona' in local languages. 
 
• Its chemical formula is Calcium Oxide (CaO).
 
• It is used for whitewashing. 
 
• It is also used for treating wounds. 
 
 
 
• Acetic Acid:
 
 
• It is also called vinegar. 
 
• Its chemical formula is CH3COOH.
 
• It is used for medical purposes and making cellulose acetate (photo film).
